say:1:1422650001:1.text: I've already said there's limited space in the warehouse this year! Offering amounts must be reduced or substituted for something else! It's all a mess, and there's simply no room!
say:1:1422650001:1.source_cn: 我都说了，今年的仓库有限，贡品需要减量和替换。现在这样...

say:2:1422650002:1.text: We've already reduced the number of offerings this year. But we still need some as backup. Otherwise, if something goes wrong, we won't have any tribute to offer.
say:2:1422650002:1.source_cn: 已经减过量了，况且贡品必须留一些备用，否则坏掉就来不及...

say:3:1422650003:1.text: If they can't be stored in the warehouse, they're all going to go bad anyway!
say:3:1422650003:1.source_cn: 塞不进仓库，你的备用品也要坏掉了！

say:5:1422650005:1.text: Bryon, come tell us what you think. Lyca and the others proposed that we should leave space in the warehouse for a proper rotation of offerings.
say:5:1422650005:1.source_cn: 布莱恩！你快来评评理！之前是莱卡她们提出的，仓库要留出...

say:6:1422650006:1.text: Therefore, the amount must be reduced, and I have already revised the request lists accordingly.
say:6:1422650006:1.source_cn: 所以单次收入的贡品量都要减少，我给出的需求单都已经是修...

say:7:1422650007:1.text: However, the offerings prepared by Lady Sandrene are excessive, and it is simply impossible for us to store them all.
say:7:1422650007:1.source_cn: 但是桑琳大人那边准备的贡品还是太多啦，根本没办法收纳！

say:8:1422650008:1.text: I've already cut the amount down as asked, but the offerings for the prayers can't be reduced any further.
say:8:1422650008:1.source_cn: 我已经根据需求减过量了，但是祈福所需要贡品也不可能减太多！

say:9:1422650009:1.text: The offerings provided this time all require time to prepare. If our reserves fall short, it will be too late to replenish them when the need arises.
say:9:1422650009:1.source_cn: 这次提供的都是需要处理时间的贡品，万一储备不够，临时添...

say:12:1422650010:1.text: Could you please introduce these two individuals and explain their positions?

say:13:1422650011:1.text: Lady Sandrene is one of the elders overseeing affairs in Ivoryshade, while Lily Jane serves as the warehouse keeper, responsible for storing and gathering offerings for Prayer Day.
say:13:1422650011:1.source_cn: 桑琳是月影乡负责处理事务的几位长老之一，拉莉洁是仓管者...

say:14:1422650012:1.text: I mean... isn't Lily Jane being a little rude to Lady Sandrene?
say:14:1422650012:1.source_cn: 我的意思是，拉莉洁是否对桑琳有点无礼？

say:15:1422650013:1.text: In my view, this is not a matter of disrespect. It is simply a clash of responsibilities.
say:15:1422650013:1.source_cn: 在我看来，这并非无礼。只是因为彼此的职责相冲而已。

say:16:1422650014:1.text: So, we should help resolve this conflict between their duties.
say:16:1422650014:1.source_cn: 那么，现在就是要调解她们工作中的冲突？

say:17:1422650015:1.text: Yes, let's lend them a hand. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have a feeling you're quite skilled when it comes to organizing things, aren't you?
say:17:1422650015:1.male: Yes, let's lend them a hand. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have a feeling you're quite skilled when it comes to organizing things, aren't you?
say:17:1422650015:1.female: Yes, let's lend them a hand. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have a feeling you're quite skilled when it comes to organizing things, aren't you?

choice_prompt:18:1422650015.text: Yes, let's lend them a hand. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have a feeling you're quite skilled when it comes to organizing things, aren't you?
choice_prompt:18:1422650015.source_cn: 嗯，我们来帮忙解决下。<style=stress><player_name></style>，印象中你很擅长收纳？
choice_prompt:18:1422650015.male: Yes, let's lend them a hand. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have a feeling you're quite skilled when it comes to organizing things, aren't you?
choice_prompt:18:1422650015.female: Yes, let's lend them a hand. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have a feeling you're quite skilled when it comes to organizing things, aren't you?

say:19:1422650016:1.text: Alright, I'll help as well. Let's try to squeeze everything in.
say:19:1422650016:1.source_cn: 那么，我也来帮忙吧，看看能不能塞进去。

say:20:1422650018:1.text: I'll lend a hand as well.

say:22:1422650017:1.text: Please see if you can sort out everything properly.
say:22:1422650017:1.source_cn: 拜托你了，看看能不能把这些多的东西整理完毕。
say:22:1422650017:1.male: Please see if you can sort out everything properly.
say:22:1422650017:1.female: Please see if you can sort out everything properly.

choice:18:1:2.text: They call me the Grand Organizer!
choice:18:1:2.male: They call me the Grand Organizer!
choice:18:1:2.female: They call me the Grand Organizer!
